name: ODF Tractometry Benchmark
description: Evaluates orientation distribution function estimation methods for tractometry using test-retest reliability and predictive capability in single-shell diffusion MRI.
typical_sota_score: 0.7–0.9 (correlation / reliability scores such as ICC or test-retest correlation)
reputation: A specialized research benchmark used in the diffusion MRI tractometry community, but not a broadly adopted general-purpose benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM medical imaging benchmark; performance is typically reported with reliability and prediction metrics rather than classification accuracy. Likely small, specialized dataset with limited community standardization.
